results.title: Indagine urbinate: "Così l'algoritmo influenza il voto"
results.snippet: Article reporting on research led by Professor Fabio Giglietto from the University of Urbino analyzing over 2.5 million Facebook posts to examine how Meta's algorithms reduced visibility for elected officials while giving greater reach to extremist accounts.

results.title: Secondo uno studio dell'università di Urbino l'algoritmo di Facebook ora punisce la politica ufficiale e premia gli estremisti antieuropei
results.snippet: News article highlighting Professor Fabio Giglietto's research into Meta's political content reduction policies, detailing how algorithmic suppression disproportionately penalized mainstream politicians compared to fringe accounts.

results.title: La città incorona i protagonisti della promozione congressuale
results.snippet: Coverage of the Premio Rimini Mundi awards ceremony, where Professor Fabio Giglietto was recognized as an ambassador for bringing major scientific and academic conferences to the region.
